Getting to Phönix.

Find us at Mühlenberg-Center, Greifswalder Straße 90 in Berlin. Travel conveniently by public transport or use the car park with 90 minutes of free parking.

By public transport

Easy to reach.

Tram M4 stops near the restaurant. You can also reach us via the Ringbahn and bus routes 156 and 158.

Tram · M4

Thomas-Mann-Straße

Get off at Thomas-Mann-Str. . From there, Mühlenberg-Center is just a short walk away.

The regular M4 route connects Hackescher Markt and Alexanderplatz with Greifswalder Straße, Weißensee and Hohenschönhausen.

S-Bahn · S41 · S42 · S8 · S85

Greifswalder Straße

Travel to S Greifswalder Str. . From there, walk along Greifswalder Straße to the restaurant.

Alternatively, take the M4 towards Weißensee / Hohenschönhausen for one stop to Thomas-Mann-Str.

Bus · 156 · 158

Take the bus to Phönix

Bus 156: Get off at Greifswalder Str./Ostseestr., then walk to Mühlenberg-Center.

Bus 158: Get off at S Greifswalder Str., then walk or take the M4 for one stop to Thomas-Mann-Str.

Plan your journey with the current BVG journey planner. It also lists works, diversions and current departures.

Find a route with BVG
By car

90 minutes of free parking.

At the Mühlenberg-Center car park, the first 90 minutes are free. The restaurant is inside the centre at Greifswalder Straße 90.

For longer stays, the parking rates displayed on site apply.
